spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** Before states of obscurity and states of enlightenment were distinguished from one another throughout the whole mind, a third divine proceeding was called forth from the Divine itself. And afterwards this power of discernment was sent into the emptiness and spiritual desolation of the external mind, so that it might purify wisdom from every contamination of falsity, and separate the state of spiritual darkness from the state of spiritual illumination, each from the other.

**¶3:** Before wisdom was released from its bondage, and freed, and elevated through the successive degrees of the mind, the Divine Source of all spiritual life prepared for it vessels of truth made luminous and beautiful. These containing forms were ordered according to divine design, so that wisdom might be refined within them, and shaped and brought into perfect spiritual form according to heavenly order.

**¶4:** Before evil had proliferated and established its dominion in the natural and corporeal mind, before those confirmed in good and those confirmed in evil were set apart from each other, the divine power of judgment was sent forth and made manifest. The seat of its authority was established and placed within the living sphere of spiritual life, so that it would render just discernment, so that there those who live from truth and good and those who live from falsity and evil would be set apart, and examined, and separated from each other.

**¶6:** Again, before human minds had been brought into being, some were designated [GAP-1] as having abundance of knowledges and truths, and others as lacking them in the natural mind, [GAP-2] according to what was inscribed upon them. Before they undergo spiritual death, those who will perish inwardly are already determined by the fixed spiritual laws and the ordained states of influx in the order of providence. These states are appointed for them; within these states lie their spiritual origins. And their inmost nature is bound up with the spiritual conditions into which they were born; and they are governed by these conditions and brought to an impartial judgment in accordance with their works from love and their falsities from evil.

**¶7:** Again, before the entire spiritual dispensation is brought to its end, [GAP-3] and the whole natural mind with it, the powers of vastation were appointed and ordained for the dissolution of that state.

**¶8:** And before the new spiritual state was [GAP-4] established and perfected in divine order and delineated according to its design, [GAP-5] the Divine Power that creates anew was called forth — the primary divine wisdom and the heavenly societies united with it — who would build and perfect the new heaven.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Before night and day were differentiated in the universe, the Third [Am]bassador was summoned. And afterwards, he was sent to this void and outer waste that he might purify the light, and separate night and day from each other.

Before the light was released and freed and ascended through this zone, the Father of Life made beautiful for it the ships of light. He constructed them so that it might be purified in them, and be sculpted and fashioned in good order.

[Bef]ore Sin had multiplied and had made a kingdom in the flesh, before the acquitted and the condemn[ed] were set apart from each other, the Judge [w]as sent forth and revealed. His throne was created and placed [i]n the living atmosphere, so that he would be a just Judge, so that there the righteous and the sinners would be set apart and tested and separated from each other.

Again, [befo]re mankind had been engendered, some were named ['rich' and] others 'poor' on earth [according to what is written] upon them. Before they die, they who will die are marked out by the stars and the signs of the zodiac in the sphere. They are appointed for them; in them are their births. And their root is bound up with their zodiacal signs; and they are compelled by them and brought to an equal judgement in accordance with their deeds and their sins.
Again, before the universe is dissolved, [and the] entire earth, the destroyers were appointed and instructed for its dissolution.

And before the ne[w] aeon was [built and] made be[auti]ful and marked out, [the] Great Builder [w]as summoned, the first architect and the angels who are with him, who would build and make beautiful the new aeon.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "abundance of knowledges and truths," which in Swedenborgian correspondence maps exactly to "rich" — spiritual wealth is wealth of knowledges and truths, while "poor" is their lack; the editor's choice perfectly fits the correspondential logic and the natural pairing with "poor" that follows.

The spiritual reading says "according to what was inscribed upon them," and the phrase "upon them" already stands in the extant text, so the gap supplies the preceding clause "according to what is written," fitting the Kephalaia's language of celestial decree and the astrological context that follows.

The spiritual reading says "and the whole natural mind with it," confirming the editor's conjunctive "and the" that links the dissolution of the universe (spiritual dispensation) with the entire earth (natural mind) in parallel construction.

The spiritual reading says "established and perfected in divine order"; "built" corresponds to "established" and pairs naturally with "made beautiful" (= perfected), and the term is reinforced by the Great Builder mentioned immediately after in the same paragraph.
The spiritual reading says "the Divine Power that creates anew was called forth," confirming the definite article "the" before "Great Builder" as the natural and grammatically required form.
